env.name: TBA_API_KEY
env.description: The Blue Alliance API key, used to fetch live event/match data. Get one free at thebluealliance.com/account. Leave blank to disable live event data.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google OAuth web client ID, used for Google sign-in. Leave blank to run guest-only, with no sign-in.

env.name: GLOBAL_ADMIN_EMAILS
env.description: Comma-separated email addresses to bootstrap as global admin on first run.

env.name: GLOBAL_ADMIN_IDS
env.description: Comma-separated Google account 'sub' IDs to bootstrap as global admin on first run.

env.name: REQUIRE_HTTPS
env.description: Reject non-HTTPS requests. Safe to leave on since the app always sits behind the platform's HTTPS reverse proxy.

env.name: LOCAL_API_ONLY
env.description: Block all non-loopback API access. Rarely needed - leave false for normal use.
